_readme: The route contract for every hand-authored page. The 47 project records are NOT here —
they come from one template through build/generate-projects.js. 11 authored + 47 generated = 58.
A key here is the source file pages-src/<key>.html. Until that file exists the build reports
the page as skipped and writes nothing, which is how a route can be decided now and built later.
Fields:
outFile   where the compiled page lands. Root .html files and projects/*.html are BUILD
OUTPUTS and are never hand-edited.
ground    the band the page opens on, per v1.3 E1. Black states, paper proves: Home, /ajman
and Services carry the narrative; Work, the records, About and Contact carry the
evidence. About is paper because §1.5a bars third-party marks from a dark ground
and the client wall is About's. Contact is paper on its own rendered facts.
navLit    which of the four nav items lights. The whole project block lights work.
navExact  whether that item also takes aria-current=page. Exact match only.
template  optional shared source: pages-src/<template>.html serves this route instead of
pages-src/<key>.html. The three sector pages are one template by decision (L1).
pageStylesheet / pageScript  opt-in per-page CSS and JS, resolved by the head/scripts partials.
assetPrefix is derived from outFile's depth; a nested route reaches assets one level up.
There is no offices sector page. The five-built rule (D-2) needs five built projects and
offices holds three, so the works room on the Work arrival is that set's home. Testimonials
is deleted outright, not redirected.
